name: speckit-beads
description: Beads-native SpecKit workflow: ships the speckit-feature bd formula (the SpecKit phase spine as a molecule DAG with human gates at clarify approval, analyze approval, and verify sign-off), steering that maps one spec dir to one molecule root epic and implementation task beads to the implement step, and a PreToolUse guard that denies every Write/Edit to specs/*/tasks.md when a beads workspace is active — task state lives in beads and tasks.md is never authored (reads stay allowed for legacy migration). Replaces the archived speckit-gate gates.yaml engine. Requires the bd CLI (gastownhall/beads >= 1.1.0); guard and steering are inert in repos without .beads/. Install the formula by copying formulas/speckit-feature.formula.toml into the repo's .beads/formulas/.
